diff --git a/tests/test_sns/test_application_boto3.py b/tests/test_sns/test_application_boto3.py
--- a/tests/test_sns/test_application_boto3.py
+++ b/tests/test_sns/test_application_boto3.py
@@ -438,6 +438,86 @@ def test_publish_to_disabled_platform_endpoint(api_key=None):
             conn.delete_platform_application(PlatformApplicationArn=application_arn)
 
 
+def _assert_endpoint_does_not_exist(err, endpoint_arn):
+    # The issue gives the error code and the "Endpoint does not exist for endpoint {endpoint_arn}"
+    # template; do not pin whether AWS omits the space between "arn" and the ARN.
+    assert err["Code"] == "InvalidParameter"
+    assert "Endpoint does not exist" in err["Message"]
+    assert endpoint_arn in err["Message"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.aws_verified
+@sns_aws_verified
+def test_publish_to_deleted_platform_endpoint(api_key=None):
+    conn = boto3.client("sns", region_name="us-east-1")
+    platform_name = str(uuid4())[0:6]
+    topic_name = "topic_" + str(uuid4())[0:6]
+    application_arn = None
+    try:
+        platform_application = conn.create_platform_application(
+            Name=platform_name,
+            Platform="GCM",
+            Attributes={"PlatformCredential": api_key},
+        )
+        application_arn = platform_application["PlatformApplicationArn"]
+
+        endpoint_arn = conn.create_platform_endpoint(
+            PlatformApplicationArn=application_arn,
+            Token="some_unique_id",
+            Attributes={"Enabled": "false"},
+        )["EndpointArn"]
+
+        topic_arn = conn.create_topic(Name=topic_name)["TopicArn"]
+
+        conn.delete_endpoint(EndpointArn=endpoint_arn)
+
+        # A deleted endpoint that was never subscribed
+        with pytest.raises(ClientError) as exc:
+            conn.subscribe(
+                TopicArn=topic_arn,
+                Endpoint=endpoint_arn,
+                Protocol="application",
+            )
+        _assert_endpoint_does_not_exist(exc.value.response["Error"], endpoint_arn)
+
+        # The example from the issue: subscribe, delete the endpoint, subscribe again
+        endpoint_arn = conn.create_platform_endpoint(
+            PlatformApplicationArn=application_arn,
+            Token="some_other_unique_id",
+        )["EndpointArn"]
+        conn.subscribe(
+            TopicArn=topic_arn,
+            Endpoint=endpoint_arn,
+            Protocol="application",
+        )
+        conn.delete_endpoint(EndpointArn=endpoint_arn)
+        with pytest.raises(ClientError) as exc:
+            conn.subscribe(
+                TopicArn=topic_arn,
+                Endpoint=endpoint_arn,
+                Protocol="application",
+            )
+        _assert_endpoint_does_not_exist(exc.value.response["Error"], endpoint_arn)
+
+        # An endpoint ARN that was never created
+        missing_arn = endpoint_arn.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/" + str(uuid4())
+        with pytest.raises(ClientError) as exc:
+            conn.subscribe(
+                TopicArn=topic_arn,
+                Endpoint=missing_arn,
+                Protocol="application",
+            )
+        _assert_endpoint_does_not_exist(exc.value.response["Error"], missing_arn)
+
+        # Other protocols do not refer to platform endpoints and still subscribe
+        conn.subscribe(TopicArn=topic_arn, Endpoint="someone@example.com", Protocol="email")
+    finally:
+        if application_arn is not None:
+            conn.delete_topic(TopicArn=topic_arn)
+
+            conn.delete_platform_application(PlatformApplicationArn=application_arn)
+
+
